newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson Land raises working capital.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land raises working capital.

text.p: HSBC Holdings Investment Bank Asia and Crdit Lyonnais said on Monday they placed 55 million shares of Henderson Land at HK$64.00 each with institutional and other investors worldwide.

The price represents a 3.4 percent discount under the stock's HK$66.25 close on Monday on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and would raise HK$3.5 billion for the company to be used as general working capital.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia and Credit Lyonnais are underwriters for the issue while HSBC James Capel, Wardley Financial Services and Credit Lyonnais are placing agents.
